name: Low temperature thermoplastics
desc: Low-temperature thermoplastic sheets can be softened at the appropriate temperature and molded to fit the body, then stretched into the required shape.

name: Air Mesh Thermoplastic Series
desc: Air Mesh Thermoplastics is an innovative medical auxiliary material made of advanced 3D mesh fabric technology and low-temperature thermoplastic polymer.

name: Thermoplastic Comfort Orthosis Series
desc: The Low-Temperature Thermoplastic Comfort Orthosis is an innovative product line specifically designed to meet the needs of medical rehabilitation and sports protection. The series includes the Thoracolumbar Orthosis, Cervico-Thoracic-Lumbar Orthosis, Lumbar Orthosis, and Pelvic Orthosis, each product aimed at providing professional support and protection to facilitate rehabilitation.

name: Adjustable Orthosis & Supports
desc: Adjustable orthoses allow real-time angle and support adjustment throughout rehabilitation, covering elbow and knee immobilization and functional training.

name: Extension Tendon Splints
desc: Extension tendon splints assist tendon movement through elastic traction for rehabilitation of extensor tendon injuries.

name: Accessory
desc: Accessories for thermoplastic sheets and prefabricated orthoses, including closures, liners and fixation aids.

name: High Temperature Thermoplastics
desc: High-temperature thermoplastic sheets deliver higher rigidity and strength for orthoses, supporting re-forming.

name: Cushion for Rehabilitation
desc: Air-powered posture cushions provide support for rehabilitation and positioning, suited to long-term bed rest and radiotherapy.

name: Patient Immobilization
desc: IFIX patient immobilization delivers reproducible, stable positioning for radiotherapy and surgical scenarios.

name: Pet Rehabilitation
desc: Veterinary orthoses and rehab aids for pet joint immobilization and post-operative recovery.
